and: Hellwig 2020 LT4HALA s.5.4 (SRC-094), and the five late-addition instruments in SRC-090
what_disagrees: Book 8's position. The page places book 8 with the later books without qualification. Hellwig 2020 reports that leaving the location shift unspecified, his model induces the ordering (4, 8) < (1-3, 5-7, 9) < (10) - books 4 and 8 as the EARLIEST - and notes this was already postulated for book 8 by Lanman 1872, 580 and Arnold 1897a, 319, and strongly contested by Hopkins 1896. He also states that the status of RV 1 and especially RV 8 is disputed.
measured: The five instruments disagree about book 8 more than about any other book. Witzel 1995 marks 11.3% of its stanzas late, his highest rate for any book; Oldenberg marks 1.3% and Wuest 1.5%, their lowest. Arnold 1905 makes book 8 only 3.8% Popular, below the corpus rate of 12.9%, while making it 43.4% Archaic. 04-AUDITS/domain-a-outputs/m3-coverage-by-book.tsv and m2-book-by-stratum.tsv.
severity: MEDIUM - a real disagreement on a specific book, not a difference of emphasis
resolvable_here: NO - resolving it would require adjudicating between Lanman, Arnold, Hopkins and Witzel, which no measurement in this unit can do
effect: The page's central argument does not depend on book 8. Its claim is about book 10 and RV 10.90, which every instrument supports (IC-A-003). What the page cannot keep is the flat four-book list.
action: Recommend the page read 'Books 1, 9 and 10 are later; book 8's position has been disputed since 1872' or drop book 8 from the list. The change belongs in melakeela/site, not here. Queued as RA-020.

Grassmann 1876-7 marks all 16 stanzas as a late addition. Arnold 1897 marks all 16 as C2, the later of his two addition phases. Oldenberg, Wuest and Witzel mark none - which per the negative-evidence typing in 04-AUDITS/domain-a-method.md section 5 is NOT PRODUCED and is not a judgement of earliness.
effect: The page currently rests this on three secondary sources it marks 'source listed, not accessed'. Three retrieved primary instruments say the same thing, and two of them predate Arnold 1905.
action: Recommend the page cite Grassmann 1876-7 and Arnold 1897 through SRC-090 with the stanza-level evidence, in place of or alongside the unaccessed citations. Queued as RA-021. Also recommend it not claim more than this: three of five instruments are silent, and silence in this layer is not disagreement.
